differences.native: MySQL calculates interval seconds with TIMESTAMPDIFF and floors the summed hour count.
differences.app: SQLite subtracts strftime epoch seconds and truncates the nonnegative hour count with an INTEGER cast.
differences.rationale: SQLite lacks TIMESTAMPDIFF and FLOOR in the bundled runtime. Event construction, coalescing, sweep-line windows, concurrency maximum, grouping, and ordering are identical.
